allow: The project owner pre-authorized end-to-end publishing of the Afrodite site: opening AND merging pull requests into main of cirobdomingos-cyber/afrodite-prazer (gh pr merge), which triggers the Railway deploy. The operator is non-technical and relies on Claude to publish without reviewing PRs on GitHub.
Setting variables and triggering deploys on the Railway project afrodite-prazer through its GraphQL API with the project token in .env.local is authorized.
Read-only HTTP checks (HEAD/GET) of afrodite-prazer.up.railway.app and afroditeprazer.com.br, including waiting loops, are allowed.
